Claim 1 (Currently amended): A regenerative braking control system for a __hybrid electric vehicle__ or __plug-in hybrid electric vehicle__, comprising: at least one sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit a sensor signal responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1 further comprising an electrical storage facility interfacing with and adapted to store electrical power from the regenerative powertrain, wherein the electrical storage facility is an energy storage device.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to at least one of a front axle and a rear axle of the vehicle, wherein the regenerative braking torque is applied to the front axle during vehicle braking.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to a selected one of front wheels and rear wheels of the vehicle, wherein the regenerative braking torque is applied to the front wheels during vehicle braking.
